about: known_failures: test name -> library bug that makes it fail. These failures do not fail the run; remove an entry once its bug is fixed.
skip_modes: run_tests.bat mode -> why the campaign is not run in that mode (it exits 0).

mednafen_args: extra mednafen settings for the campaign (timer_pal starts mednafen as a European, PAL console). mednafen saves them in its config: campaigns without mednafen_args pass -ss.region_autodetect 1 instead.

known_failures.ascii_set_color_palette_1: SetColor finds the palette with colorBank >> 6 (64 bytes per palette, not 32): with palette 1 it writes color 33 (palette 2), not 17
known_failures.ascii_print_stops_at_map_end: Print clamps the start cell but not the end: text past cell (63, 63) is written after the map, past the end of VDP2 VRAM (it lands on the start of VRAM A0 through the mirror)
known_failures.palette_test_wrapped_colors_not_freed: Bitmap::Palette's destructor deletes Colors also when Palette(colors, count) wrapped the caller's array

known_failures.interrupt_test_acknowledge_roundtrip: Get/SetAcknowledge use 0x25FE00BC, which is not an SCU register (AIACK is 0x25FE00A8): the value does not read back
known_failures.system_test_clock_mode_roundtrip: not run: SetClockMode resets VDP1, VDP2 and SCSP as documented, and SRL has no function that re-initializes them, so the next Synchronize never returns (the campaign hangs)
known_failures.interrupt_test_illegal_instruction_handl: Interrupt::Vector uses the 68000's exception numbers: Vector::Illegal is 0x63, but the SH-2 takes an illegal instruction on vector 4, which SetHandler refuses (it only takes 0x40-0x4F and 0x60-0x8F)

known_failures.wave_mono_16bit: 16-bit mono samples lose their high byte: samples[0] | samples[1] has no << 8 (srl_sound.hpp)
known_failures.wave_stereo_16bit: 16-bit stereo stores the right channel first, 8-bit stereo the left channel first
known_failures.wave_stereo_8bit: not run: 8-bit stereo writes the right channel at data[dataSize + sample], past the end of its buffer
known_failures.tga_rle_paletted_16: 16-color RLE decoding reads two source pixels per pixel count and the next packet byte as a color

known_failures.slave_is_done_seen_by_master: ITask::IsDone() reads the master's cache, which keeps the value from before the slave finished
known_failures.slave_reset_task_while_running: ResetTask() returns !done, which is true while the task runs (documented: false)

known_failures.scene_attribute_paletted_texture: the texture Attribute constructor sets UsePalette, then overwrites Sort without it

known_failures.string_snprintfEx_fixed_point: %f rounds the decimals down: 1.5 prints as 1.49999
known_failures.string_snprintfEx_percent_literal: %% prints % but also skips the next character: "50%% done" gives "50%done"
known_failures.string_snprintfEx_truncates_inside_buffe: a text longer than the buffer is not terminated inside it; the '\0' goes to buffer[length], past its end
known_failures.string_copy_of_empty: copy constructor, assignment and + call strlen(nullptr) on an empty string

known_failures.vdp1_available_memory: GetAvailableMemory() with no texture shifts CGADDRESS by 3 again (already a byte offset) and wraps to about 4 GB

known_failures.vdp2_vram_access_cycles: bankCycles starts at -1 for A0-B0 but at 2 for B1, so B1 gives 5 cycles, not 6
known_failures.vdp2_load_tilemap_then_clear: ClearVRAM frees NBG0-NBG3 palettes with RBG0's color mode, so a 16-color bank stays used
known_failures.vdp2_load_bitmap_16_colors_vram_size: AutoAllocateBmp writes `sz >= 1` (a comparison) instead of `sz >>= 1`, so a 16-color bitmap takes twice its VRAM (128 KB for 512x256)
known_failures.vdp2_default_sprite_priorities: VDP2::Initialize calls SpriteLayer::SetPriority twice on Bank0 (Layer3 then Layer4): bank 0 ends on layer 4 and bank 1 keeps SGL's layer 5, not the documented 3 and 4
known_failures.vdp2_sprite_opacity_full: SpriteLayer::SetOpacity(1.0) computes ratio 31 - 32 = -1: CCRSA gets 0xFF, bank 0 ratio 31 (the most transparent) instead of 0

skip_modes.USBGamers: the sound driver files are loaded from the disc, which the DevCart upload does not send

known_failures.cdda_resume_after_pause: Resume does not stop at the end of the paused track and plays on into track 3: it looks the next track up as Tracks[TargetTrack + 1] (that is track TargetTrack + 2), in a table whose entries are 8 bytes instead of 4 (see cd_test_tray_and_table_details), so it plays to the end of the disc
known_failures.cinepak_load_twice: LoadMovie does not unload the movie already loaded: its file stays open, so with one GFS file at a time the second LoadMovie cannot open the movie

known_failures.transform_set_matrix_matches_matrix43: SGL reads a Matrix43 row as a column: Matrix43::TransformPoint uses Row0-Row2 as rows, SGL (and Matrix43::CreateRotation*) as columns, so they turn points opposite ways (SaturnMathPP)

known_failures.tilemap_bmp2tile_refuses_partial_tiles: the size check masks 16x16 characters with 0x7 instead of 0xf (byte width and height), so 24-pixel 256-color bitmaps are converted with drifting rows
known_failures.tilemap_bmp2tile_refused_no_leak: a refused bitmap sets cellData, mapData and palData to NULL without deleting them (3 blocks leak)
known_failures.tilemap_load_into_nbg1_2word: Map2VRAM puts the palette at bit 20 of 2-word map data: right for 256 colors, but 16-color palettes belong at bit 16

known_failures.draw2d_rotated_sprite_zoom_point: the rotated path offsets the corners by -halfSize for UpperLeft (and the other zoom points), so the sprite is drawn on the opposite side of its location
known_failures.draw2d_rotated_sprite_size: the rotated path uses corners at +-halfSize, one pixel more than the unrotated scaled sprite (VDP1 coordinates are inclusive)
